title: Events, Retreats and Gatherings | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Host a shower, reunion or retreat at R&SVP in Bridgton, Maine. Tables and chairs included. Sundays and weekdays, May through October. Ask Susan about your event.
heading: Lunch in the barn. *An afternoon together.*
lede: Our barn gives your family a place to sit down together, with a patio for catching up outside. We host private events on Sundays and weekdays, May through October. Our total event capacity is 135. Tables and chairs are included, and our events are alcohol free.
hero_alt: The barn with round tables set on the patio, lawn in front

kinds.title: Baby and wedding showers
kinds.body: The round tables give family and friends a place to sit together for a shower. We have a prep kitchen for your caterer and a patio beside the barn.

kinds.title: Reunions and birthdays
kinds.body: A birthday or reunion brings relatives back around the table. Tell Susan how many people you're inviting so you can discuss a seating arrangement and the rental rate.

kinds.title: Retreats and company gatherings
kinds.body: We welcome women's retreats and company gatherings in the barn. The patio offers a place to continue conversations between sessions. Contact Susan about your plans.

kinds.title: Small concerts
kinds.body: The High Street Jazz Band played beneath the beams at our open house. We welcome inquiries about small concerts inside the barn. Susan can explain the sound limits before you book.

kinds.title: Teas and workshops
kinds.body: We host teas and creative workshops around the barn tables. Contact Susan about renting the space for your group. For classes you can attend, see the announcements below.

kinds.title: Community events
kinds.body: We want this farm to serve our neighbors, too. We've pledged to donate use of the venue for one charitable event each year. Contact Susan about what you have in mind.

classes.heading: Join us around the craft tables
classes.body: We've hosted papercrafting and fall cardmaking in the barn. At our October gathering, guests toured the venue and spent time outside by the flowerbeds. We post class dates and sign up details on Facebook.
classes.alt: Guests beside the stone planter at the barn on a fall afternoon

upcoming_empty: Our Facebook page has the latest event announcements. Contact Susan if you'd like to ask about a class.

retreats.heading: A place for parents to connect
retreats.body: Susan worked in special education and has a daughter with autism. We hope to host retreats where parents of children with disabilities can hear a guest speaker and talk with one another. [CONFIRM: ready to announce]

closing.heading: Your next gathering at the barn
closing.body: Tell Susan about your event and roughly how many guests you're inviting. You can ask about the rental and available dates before making plans.
